about_the_game:
Next Player is a first-person psychological horror game set in the autumn of 2001. While rummaging through forgotten boxes in a dusty attic, you find an unlabeled game cartridge. It has no writing on it, but you insert the cartridge into the old console anyway. When you turn on the TV, a single title appears: “Next Player”.

Succumbing to curiosity, you start playing. At first glance, everything seems normal; it feels like you are just playing an old game. But as you clear the levels, the game begins to reveal its true, dark nature. This ordinary night is about to spiral into an unexpected nightmare...

FEATURES

  • Game Within a Game: A layered horror experience where the boundaries between your room and the world on the screen slowly blur.

  • Claustrophobic Atmosphere: Set in a single room, featuring a reality that distorts and closes in on you with each loop.

  • Simple Gameplay: Just a 25–30 minute horror experience, completed in a single sitting as you examine your surroundings and interact with the TV.

Put on your headphones. Turn off the lights.

And finally, make sure your door is locked.

Because it is now on your side.

WARNING: This game contains flashing lights, loud noises, and visual glitches. Please play with caution if you are prone to epileptic seizures.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Headphones are essential for the best experience.
